description: Delete files, directories, and symlinks. Use when a path should no longer exist. Do not use it to rename or relocate; use `move` instead, and `undo` to restore. A symlink is removed, never its target. A non-empty directory needs `recursive: true`; without it, that path fails INVALID_INPUT. With it, the user must confirm. Nothing is deleted until every prompt is answered. A client that cannot prompt fails the whole call INVALID_INPUT. Deleting a folder that holds protected files cannot be undone. Other failures hit only their own path: ACCESS_DENIED for a root, read-only, or outside path; CANCELLED when refused or changed; INVALID_INPUT for a nested pair. Returns per-path { deleted } or { error } (a skipped prompt gives deleted: false), a summary, and an undo id valid 30 minutes, or undoUnavailable with the reason.

ignoreIfNotExists.description: True: a missing path returns deleted: true instead of failing NOT_FOUND

paths.description: Exact paths (no globs): files, directories, or symlinks. Duplicates collapse

items.description: File or directory path inside a root, absolute or relative to it.

recursive.description: Required for a non-empty directory, else INVALID_INPUT.

name: delete
title: Delete Paths
